text: Hello! I was living in Israel with my Israeli partner (now spouse) with the B1 then A5 visa for 3 years. We decided fo leave last year, and MH told us they automatically close our case after my visa expires (it expired in March 2026). We plan to come back to visit family for a few weeks in Sept 2026, and I plan to enter on a tourist visa. Is there any problem with entering as a tourist shortly after my A5 expired?
